partners.mechanism_chain: MAGT1 (HGNC:24103) —DISRUPTS→ Magnesium transport and homeostasis (GO:0005513); Magnesium transport and homeostasis (GO:0005513) —DECREASES→ ATP synthesis (GO:0006074); ATP synthesis (GO:0006074) —LEADS_TO→ X-linked immunodeficiency with magnesium defect, Epstein-Barr virus infection and neoplasia (MONDO:0010455); GYG1 (HGNC:23498) —DISRUPTS→ Glycogen metabolism (GO:0005977); Glycogen metabolism (GO:0005977) —DECREASES→ Glucose (CHEBI:17234); Glucose (CHEBI:17234) —DECREASES→ ATP synthesis (GO:0006074); ATP synthesis (GO:0006074) —LEADS_TO→ Glycogen storage disease XV (MONDO:0013291). Loss-of-function mutations in MAGT1 disrupt magnesium transport, impairing numerous cellular processes including ATP synthesis, leading to X-linked immunodeficiency with magnesium defect. Similarly, loss-of-function mutations in GYG1 disrupt glycogen metabolism, leading to reduced glucose availability for ATP synthesis, causing glycogen storage disease XV. Both pathways converge on the critical downstream process of ATP synthesis, highlighting a shared vulnerability in cellular energy production that underlies the distinct phenotypes of these diseases.

partners.mechanism_chain: MAGT1 (HGNC:29830) —DISRUPTS→ Magnesium ion (CHEBI:29101); Magnesium ion (CHEBI:29101) —DECREASES→ T-cell activation and function (GO:0002694); T-cell activation and function (GO:0002694) —LEADS_TO→ Immune dysfunction (HP:0002715); HBB (HGNC:4827) —DISRUPTS→ Abnormal Hemoglobin M (MONDO:0018023); Abnormal Hemoglobin M (MONDO:0018023) —DISRUPTS→ Erythropoiesis (GO:0001841); Erythropoiesis (GO:0001841) —LEADS_TO→ Hemoglobinopathy (HP:0001911).
